text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooooooooooah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume charge forward in unison! 
Will they let the front-runner steal the 
win?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! ...Ngh! Heh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh crap, I can already hear her 
footsteps. Her acceleration is on a whole 
'nother level compared to before...!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. I want to win. I want to 
win. I want to win......... I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —I won't back down!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... gh, ...gh!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan... chan...

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: The next Derby is...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the waiting room, Ines Fujin 
murmured as she pressed a hand against her 
burning body.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Running a race where someone's keeping 
their eyes on you feels completely 
different from before, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It was completely different.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Getting 1st place in the Derby might be a 
lot harder than I thought.
choice_data_list: Still, you want 1st place, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, totally... I felt that big time after 
I finished running!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to run faster than anyone else 
here. I wanted... to stand at the very 
front.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll get faster. Faster and faster...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we'll win as the race favorite.
Yeah, I'll win as the favorite!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha, you actually said it! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Still, maybe that's for the best.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I'll become the center of everyone's 
attention just like today, compete against 
them all, and seize first place!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on TV
text_block_list.text:
"—Ever since I was born an Umamusume, 
becoming a Derby Umamusume has been my 
dream."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Magazine Interview
text_block_list.text:
"—Ever since I was born an Umamusume, 
there has been only one title I've strived 
for."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —I'm an Umamusume too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, tomorrow is a day off. And the 
day after that, we train.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good night, Trainer. Have a sound sleep 
and sweet dreams~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer. Making me win as the 
favorite... Just how high are your 
expectations for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops, whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Whoops, that was close. It'd be 
quite shameful to get injured from 
carelessness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If it's precious to you, I want to 
treasure it too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘If it's precious to you, I want to 
cherish it too.’"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Just like how you protected the things 
that were precious to me."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to treasure the things you 
hold dear, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...We're definitely going to win the 
Derby. Trainer.
